name: Ipratropium Nebuliser Solution
dosing: Acute: 500 micrograms QDS PRN. Can combine with salbutamol
monitoring: Respiratory function, heart rate, ocular symptoms
sideEffects: Dry mouth, cough, headache, rarely paradoxical bronchospasm, glaucoma (if nebuliser mist reaches eyes)
pharmacokinetics: Inhaled, minimal systemic absorption, onset 15min, peak 1-2h
clinicalPearls: Add to salbutamol in severe asthma/COPD. Protect eyes during nebulisation (mouthpiece better than mask). Slower onset than salbutamol but longer duration
indication: Acute asthma (adjunct to β2-agonists), COPD exacerbation
